dimensions.note: The model holds no credentials and makes no network calls. The Jev key is read by @swamp/typesafe-ai from the typesafe vault, not by this model.
load and reply log at info on entry and on completion with structured properties (tested), and never log the turn text.

load throws on an unreadable turn file before writing (tested). reply's inputs are validated by zod; a missing or unknown route answer is recorded as llm with a reason rather than thrown, so the workflow fails open.
21 unit tests: cleaning, hashing, empty turns, cut-off, reply reasons and elapsedMs, load failure, reply writing one resource, and log order. 22 hook and workflow tests run against a fake swamp.
Each method writes one fixed-name resource as a new version; repeating a run adds a version and changes nothing else.
No external API; Jev is called by the @swamp/typesafe-ai step in the workflow.
load reads the turn file with Deno.readTextFile and holds no handle. The hook, which creates the file, removes it.
Manifest publishes README, LICENSE, the model and the workflow. README has no IPs, hostnames, account ids or personal paths; private visibility.
Plain z.object schemas with enums and iso datetimes; no passthrough.
turn and reply: lifetime 14d, garbageCollection 2000, so a week of shadow turns is kept and then expires.
Not a lifecycle model; two stateless per-turn methods.
Methods change nothing outside swamp data.
load writes turn/turn and reply writes reply/reply; no overlap. Every schema field is written (checked field by field).
Reads no stored data; reply gets the route through workflow inputs.
First published version; no earlier schema to upgrade from.
